_comment: FormList Manipulator (FLM, D-4). Emits <file>_FLM.ini at the mod root — appends forms to ANY already-loaded FormList (vanilla / another mod's) at runtime with NO esp override = zero conflict. For a FLST you OWN, build it esp-side with formLists[] instead. Requires FormListManipulator.dll at runtime; FLM resolves the refs against the player's load order (ModForge only checks structure).

filters._comment: Only run when HearthFires is active.
filters.name: HFFilter

aliases._comment: Group several target FLSTs so one line writes to all of them.
aliases.name: AdoptionGiftLists

collections._comment: Batch-select by FormType + keyword (all iron war axes).
collections.name: IronWarAxes

entries._comment: Add the Dolls group to every adoption gift list, only if HearthFires is present.
Add my own spell into an external mod's spell pool FLST (no override).
